content.text:
Model the vintage robbie the banker coin bank toy using the reference image

Reference files (read them, don't modify them), in ./references/:
- ./references/robie.jpg

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.
I’ll inspect the reference, build the toy in Blender, then render and check it before exporting the GLB and final images.

The reference shows a compact yellow cylindrical robot with a tilted head, recessed round eyes, black hands, and a coin tray. I’m modeling those features as separate parts so they remain clear in the interactive viewer.

import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
os.makedirs('output',exist_ok=True)
def mat(n,c,metal=0,rough=.34):
 m=bpy.data.materials.new(n); m.diffuse_color=(*c,1); m.use_nodes=True; p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF'); p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*c,1); p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal; p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; return m
yellow=mat('warm lacquer yellow',(0.94,.72,.025),0,.25)
gold=mat('yellow highlight',(1,.82,.055),0,.25)
black=mat('black molded plastic',(.012,.014,.018),0,.32)
dark=mat('dark eye rims',(.07,.055,.035),.35,.25)
silver=mat('smoky silver eyes',(.51,.49,.43),.55,.15)
white=mat('white graphics',(.92,.92,.84))
def assign(o,m): o.data.materials.append(m); return o
def cyl(n,loc,r,depth,m,vertices=64,rot=None):
 bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=r,depth=depth,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=n
 if rot:o.rotation_euler=rot
 assign(o,m); bevel=o.modifiers.new('soft molded edge','BEVEL');bevel.width=.035;bevel.segments=3; o.modifiers.new('weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL'); return o
def uv(n,loc,scale,m):
 bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=32,ring_count=16,location=loc);o=bpy.context.object;o.name=n;o.scale=scale;assign(o,m);bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth();return o
def curve(n,pts,r,m):
 cu=bpy.data.curves.new(n,'CURVE');cu.dimensions='3D';cu.bevel_depth=r;cu.bevel_resolution=4;s=cu.splines.new('BEZIER');s.bezier_points.add(len(pts)-1)
 for p,v in zip(s.bezier_points,pts):p.co=v;p.handle_left_type='AUTO';p.handle_right_type='AUTO'
 o=bpy.data.objects.new(n,cu);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o);assign(o,m);return o
def txt(n,s,loc,size,m,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0)):
 cu=bpy.data.curves.new(n,'FONT');cu.body=s;cu.size=size;cu.extrude=.001;cu.align_x='CENTER';o=bpy.data.objects.new(n,cu);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o);o.location=loc;o.rotation_euler=rot;assign(o,m);return o
# Body and black lower rim
cyl('black bottom rim',(0,0,.28),1.04,.18,black)
cyl('rounded yellow body',(0,0,1.06),1.05,1.55,yellow)
cyl('neck dark separation',(0,0,1.88),.99,.11,black)
# head cylinder with slight rear tilt
head=cyl('tilted head',(0,.08,2.25),1.08,.78,gold,96,rot=(math.radians(-7),0,0))
cyl('black top panel',(0,.13,2.67),1.03,.052,black,96,rot=(math.radians(-7),0,0))
# eyes facing toward front, horizontal discs
for x in (-.34,.34):
 cyl('eye socket',(x,-.962,2.35),.247,.045,dark,64,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0))
 cyl('silver eye bezel',(x,-1.001,2.35),.207,.045,silver,64,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0))
 uv('smoky domed eye',(x,-1.039,2.35),(.173,.065,.173),silver)
 uv('black lower pupil',(x,-1.095,2.265),(.095,.028,.06),black)
 uv('eye gloss',(x-.05,-1.104,2.43),(.053,.008,.035),white)
# mouth slit and two white teeth
cyl('mouth shadow',(0,-1.008,1.936),.32,.016,black,48,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0))
for x in (-.08,.08):uv('little tooth',(x,-1.026,1.932),(.045,.035,.067),white)
# center body seam and ROBIE word
curve('body center seam',[(0,-1.057,.40),(0,-1.06,.95),(0,-1.052,1.77)],.007,dark)
txt('ROBIE front mark','ROBIE',(-.48,-1.064,1.52),.19,black)
# shoulder caps and arms
for side in (-1,1):
 x=side*1.09
 cyl('round shoulder housing',(x,0,1.45),.32,.30,yellow,48,rot=(0,math.pi/2,0))
 cyl('shoulder inner disc',(side*1.24,0,1.45),.26,.045,gold,48,rot=(0,math.pi/2,0))
 curve('bent black arm',[(side*1.24,-.03,1.35),(side*1.29,-.16,1.05),(side*1.43,-.44,.78)],.075,black)
# left curled gripper
curve('left outer grip',[(-1.43,-.44,.78),(-1.57,-.62,.65),(-1.53,-.78,.49),(-1.34,-.78,.48),(-1.37,-.68,.61)],.092,black)
curve('left inner grip',[(-1.43,-.48,.74),(-1.36,-.61,.64),(-1.27,-.66,.52),(-1.36,-.73,.43)],.079,black)
# right serving tray: flat circular platter atop hand
cyl('tray stem',(1.48,-.52,.75),.16,.12,black)
cyl('coin serving tray',(1.50,-.61,.84),.51,.07,black,64,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0))
cyl('tray printed ring',(1.50,-.66,.84),.36,.007,white,64,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0))
cyl('tray inner black',(1.50,-.667,.84),.32,.008,black,64,rot=(math.pi/2,0,0))
txt('dollar on tray','$',(1.49,-.681,.65),.39,white)
# feet and black soles
for side in (-1,1):
 uv('black sole',(side*1.12,-.32,.16),(.58,.48,.14),black)
 uv('yellow rounded foot',(side*1.12,-.34,.25),(.55,.44,.21),yellow)
# top grooves
for i in range(6):
 curve('top panel fine grooves',[(-.43+i*.035,-.38,2.714),(-.43+i*.035,.64,2.68)],.006,dark)
txt('top panel brand','Radio Shack',(0,.16,2.704),.11,white,rot=(0,0,0))
# floor and camera; floor excluded on GLB later
floor=cyl('studio floor',(0,0,-.015),200,.02,mat('studio background',(.68,.70,.72)),64)
camera_data=bpy.data.cameras.new('Camera');camera=bpy.data.objects.new('Camera',camera_data);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(camera);camera.location=(4,-7,4.2);target=Vector((0,0,1.43));camera.rotation_euler=(target- camera.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler();camera_data.type='ORTHO';camera_data.ortho_scale=5.5;bpy.context.scene.camera=camera
def area(n,loc,power,size):
 d=bpy.data.lights.new(n,'AREA');d.energy=power;d.shape='DISK';d.size=size;o=bpy.data.objects.new(n,d);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o);o.location=loc;o.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,1.3))-o.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
area('large softbox',(-3,-4,7),1000,5);area('right fill',(4,-1,4),500,4)
scene=bpy.context.scene;scene.render.engine='CYCLES';scene.cycles.samples=32;scene.render.resolution_x=1000;scene.render.resolution_y=1000;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.world.color=(.55,.55,.55);scene.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG';scene.render.filepath=os.path.abspath('output/robie_front.png');bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
# export only toy geometry, no stage or lights/camera
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
 if o.type in {'MESH','CURVE','FONT'} and o!=floor:o.select_set(True)
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=os.path.abspath('output/robie.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True)
result={'objects':len(bpy.context.scene.objects),'render':scene.render.filepath,'glb':os.path.abspath('output/robie.glb')}
